primary_sources.source_name: BSE Annual Report Filings — Manufacturing segment
primary_sources.notes: Manufacturing EBITDA margins median: 12–18% across diversified industrials (BSE/MCA21 XBRL FY2024).
Material cost, employee benefit expense, depreciation, other expenses breakdown.
Industrial electricity tariff and energy intensity benchmarks.

source_metadata.methodology: Diversified manufacturing opex ratios from MCA21/BSE disclosures and CEA energy statistics. Heavy vs light manufacturing mix may vary — use sector-specific packs where available.

RAW_MATERIALS.source_note: Material cost as % of revenue for diversified manufacturing (MCA21 Schedule III).

CONVERSION_COST.source_note: Direct labour + manufacturing overhead + plant depreciation (ex-raw materials and energy). Decomposed from MCA21 Schedule III: Employee Benefit Expense (~9%), Depreciation (~4%), manufacturing overhead subset of Other Expenses (~5%). Cross-checked against CII Manufacturing Excellence cost-structure disclosures and BSE FY24 filings (Tata Motors, UltraTech, Pidilite).

PLANT_MAINTENANCE.source_note: Maintenance & repairs 2-4% of revenue for asset-heavy plants (CII plant engineering benchmarks; MCA21 repairs-to-machinery disclosures).

POWER_ENERGY.source_note: Power & fuel as % of revenue from MCA21 Schedule III; CEA industrial tariff statistics FY24. Varies with segment energy intensity.

PACKAGING.source_note: Packing material consumption for discrete/process mix (Schedule III packing materials line).

raw_material_procurement.source_note: Procurement function operating cost (people + systems) as % of revenue; ISM/CIPS procurement cost benchmarks.

energy_utilities_plant.source_note: Plant utilities (power, steam, compressed air, water) share of conversion cost; CEA + PAT-cycle disclosures.

maintenance_spares.source_note: Spares & consumables inventory consumption; MRO spend studies (Ardent Partners 2024).

quality_testing.source_note: QA/QC labs, testing, certification and cost of poor quality remediation; ASQ COPQ studies.

pli_scheme_costs.source_note: PLI scheme compliance, certification and claim administration for participating manufacturers (MeitY/DPIIT scheme guidelines).

ehs_environment.source_note: EHS compliance, effluent treatment, CPCB/SPCB consent costs and BRSR environmental reporting.

inbound_logistics.source_note: Inbound freight & handling; India logistics cost studies (NCAER 2023 logistics cost ~7.8-8.9% of GDP).

outbound_logistics.source_note: Outbound/secondary freight incl. warehousing; MCA21 freight & forwarding disclosures.

contract_manufacturing.source_note: Third-party conversion/job-work charges where outsourced manufacturing is used (Schedule III job work expenses).

r_and_d_expense.source_note: R&D revenue expenditure per DSIR-recognised unit disclosures; diversified industrials median ~1%.
